differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a low angle close to the keys, creating a dramatic perspective with shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned high above the keys, looking down at a flat angle with a wide field of view.
differences.fix: Lower the camera height and adjust the focal length to match the low-angle perspective.

differences.a_observable: The crevices between the keys are dark with deep shadows, creating strong contrast and depth.
differences.b_observable: The crevices are brightly lit with very soft, faint shadows, making the layout look flat.
differences.fix: Increase the shadow depth and ambient occlusion in the gaps between the keys.

differences.a_observable: The yellow key has a warm, saturated golden hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow key has a cooler, less saturated lemon-yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the color of the yellow key material to be warmer and more saturated.

json.highest_impact_fix: Reposition the camera lower to the surface and adjust the focal length to match the dramatic perspective and depth of field of the reference video.
